title: Are You the 'Rush to the Gate Just to Wait' Person?
description: Discover your true airport personality. Do you panic-wait for hours, or sprint at the final call?

questions.text: When do you arrive at the airport?

choices.label: 4 hours early. I'm already at the gate.
2 hours early. Perfectly on time.
2 hours early, but I'm at Starbucks.
Boarding time? What's that?
Packed 3 days ago. Checked 10 times.
Packed last night. Checklist ticked.
Packed some, will buy the rest at Duty-Free.
Throwing things in a bag on the way.

questions.text: While waiting at the gate, you are...

choices.label: Staring intensely at the boarding screen.
Reading a book, neck pillow ready.
Walking around looking at perfumes.
Running through the terminal, sweating.

questions.text: You hear a loudspeaker announcement. You...

choices.label: Panic! Is my flight canceled?!
Listen calmly, then ignore it.
Don't hear it, too busy shopping.
Hear 'Final Call' and start sprinting.
Stand in line before it even opens.
Wait seated until the line shrinks.
Join the line with a shopping bag.
Beg the staff not to close the door.
